description: Search what Fudge knows about this store: memory guides, Plans, projects, findings, recommendations, recorded changes, messages between Fudge’s agents and past conversations. Pass `about` (a URL, Shopify GID or fudge:// ref) for everything related to one thing. Conversation results say whether the work is a draft, was published or was only discussed.

about.description: ID, storefront URL/path or file that results must relate to.

store.description: The connected store to use. Omit when only one is connected.

edited.description: File or entity directly edited; kind project or conversation.

name: find_context
title: Find store context
